Samples collected in March and June 2016

Source: R/water_samples.R
water_samples.Rd

Samples collected in March and June 2016

Usage

water_samples

Format

A tibble with 157 rows and 80 variables

localization

Name of the localization where the sample was taken.

geology

Composition of the ground.

utm_x

Geospatial data of the water sampling locations. The geographic coordinate system 'Arc 1960 / UTM zone 37S' (EPSG:21037) which is used for the areas of Kenya and Tanzania - south of equator and east of 36°E.

utm_y

Geospatial data of the water sampling locations. The geographic coordinate system 'Arc 1960 / UTM zone 37S' (EPSG:21037) which is used for the areas of Kenya and Tanzania - south of equator and east of 36°E.

date

Date the sample was taken.

conductivity

Conductivity of the sample in (µS/cm)

T_avg

Average ambient temperature at the time of the sampling

pH

Acidity/basicity of the sample using the pH value.

TOC

Total organic carbon (TOC) is an analytical parameter representing the concentration of organic carbon in a sample.

alkalinity

Alkalinity of the sample as mg of bicarbonate (HCO3) per liter (mg_HCO3/L).

DO

Dissolved oxygen (DO) levels in environmental water depend on the physiochemical and biochemical activities in water body and it is an important useful in pollution and waste treatment process control.

ORP

Oxidation reduction potential (ORP) in (mV).

eH

Redox potential (eH) in (mV).

NH4

Ammonium concentration in (mg/L).

Cl

Chlorine concentration in (mg/L)

Sulfate concentration in (mg/L)

Nitrate concentration in (mg/L)

delta_O_18

The ratio of stable isotopes oxygen-18 (18O) and oxygen-16 (16O) as a measure of groundwater/mineral interactions.

delta_H_2

δ2H, or delta deuterium, is a measure of the relative abundance of deuterium (a stable isotope of hydrogen) in a sample, often used in hydrology and environmental science to trace the origin and movement of water.
